Application Data.NAME: Sandy's Deli and Sandwich Shop
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sandy's Deli and Sandwich Shop specializes in serving high-quality sandwiches, salads, and gourmet delicacies to our customers. We focus on using fresh, locally sourced ingredients and offer a range of quick meal options, including vegetarian and gluten-free selections. Our operations involve minimal food preparation with no cooking, utilizing only household-type appliances like panini presses and toasters. We also provide catering services for small events, ensuring a delightful experience for our clients. With an emphasis on customer satisfaction and food safety, we strive to maintain a clean and welcoming environment for all patrons.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a minor electrical issue caused a temporary malfunction of our panini press, requiring repair. The cost of the repair was $300, and it was resolved within two days without significant disruption to operations. On 07/28/2022, a slight water leak from the HVAC system was detected, leading to a repair cost of $450. This issue was addressed promptly, and operations continued smoothly. Both incidents were minor and did not affect our total revenue or customer service.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL Listed, 1-Hour Fire Rated Safe
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Central Station Alarm System, 24/7 monitoring, security cameras installed, perimeter fencing, and a security personnel presence during operating hours.

Delicatessens & Sandwich Shops
Underwriting Appetite
The underwriting appetite for delicatessens and sandwich shops is
primarily influenced by the type and extent of food preparation, cooking methods, revenue size,
and ancillary operations such as alcohol sales or catering. These factors directly impact the risk
profile related to fire hazards, food safety, and liability exposures.
• Preferred:
– Establishments with no cooking or only the use of household-type appliances (e.g., mi-
crowave ovens, toasters, panini presses) that do not generate open flames or significant
heat.
– Annual gross revenue less than $500,000, indicating a smaller scale operation with po-
tentially lower exposure.
